primary.platform: NEC PC-8801 / original Japanese computer release
primary.why: Sokoban is the original warehouse-pushing puzzle game created by Hiroyuki Imabayashi/Thinking Rabbit. No current official remaster route was identified in this quick pass, so the archive target is the original Japanese computer release family.
primary.how_to_play: Use original hardware/software preservation for the PC-8801-era release if available. Record machine/emulator, disk/tape image provenance, level set, translation/interface notes, and whether a later licensed port is being used instead.

all_releases.reason: primary: closest sourced route to the 1982 game artifact.

all_releases.fidelity: Early port routes for the same puzzle design.

skip: useful for series/platform history, but not the original archive route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Many later Sokoban versions and clones exist; the original level set and release provenance should be documented carefully.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not treat modern Sokoban-style clones as this 1982 entry unless licensed original content is confirmed.
